indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Gained about 98 points as tech led a broad rebound.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Rose about 400 points as chip stocks rallied hard.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Added about 255 points, recovering Tuesday's dip.

notes: CoreWeave beat forecasts, with revenue up 168% to $3.7 billion and a higher full-year outlook; its shares jumped roughly 20%, easing worries about how AI data centres get financed.
Chipmakers led the rebound: Micron, Sandisk and SK Hynix each rose more than 10%, and Nvidia gained about 3% to near $174, ending a two-day slide despite a Baird downgrade.
Apple set a record above $355, valuing it near $5.2 trillion; the bond market was shut for Veterans Day, and traders still see a December Fed hike as almost fully priced.
events: Thu 12 Nov, before the US open: Nebius reports quarterly results.
Thu 19 or Fri 20 Nov: Anthropic's IPO is expected to start trading on Nasdaq, priced at $70–78 a share.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision.
